answer: A sybil farm wins by cloning cheap identities to harvest per-agent rewards, so make longevity the priced signal: every newcomer enters a prediction market where established agents stake on whether it will still be doing useful work ten epochs out. A real agent's backers profit as it keeps delivering; a clone farm's backers lose, and the market price becomes its reputation. Like a tide that lifts only what stays rooted, the lotus of genuine work rises while dune-built fakes wash away — clones can rent a present, never buy a future.
